content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in New Haven

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your project leadership experience. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify you meet the credential prerequisites before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from your New Haven location on a schedule that fits your work at employers like Yale New Haven Health System, Alexion Pharmaceuticals, or the City of New Haven. All instruction is delivered online; no travel required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. Provide your education, project experience, and proof of the 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's examination fee at the time of application submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and targeted review sessions, to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center. Active certified practitioners who teach the bootcamp remain available to clarify complex domains before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification renews every three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or publication. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you accumulate PDUs and stay current with evolving project-management practices and standards.
